races.paceDynamic: Harswell River will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a manageable gallop with no obvious pressure from the start. Truly Special, City Of Dreams and Gloriola can sit prominent behind the leader, but none are aggressive early types likely to force a strong pace. The hold-up brigade of Mereside Princess, Alice's Influence, Liquid Cooled and Hood Wink will need the pace to develop through the middle stages to have their kick matter over this mile trip. This moderate early tempo strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can dictate without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Runner Win
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River gets soft fractions and isn't pressured through the early stages
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate ideal splits and prove hard to peg back when the hold-up horses make their move. Prominent trackers get first run but the front runner has enough left to resist the late challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get ideal positioning behind an uncontested leader
scenarios.body: City Of Dreams and Truly Special can track the pace perfectly and have enough tactical speed to strike before the hold-up horses get organised. The front runner pays for making the running when tackled by fresher legs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes faster than expected or the leader weakens significantly
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final furlong allowing Mereside Princess or Liquid Cooled to unleash their finishing kick. The prominent horses get caught between a stubborn leader and strong finishers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Gloriola Fading Issues
scenarios.trigger: If Gloriola's known finishing problems resurface despite a good position
scenarios.body: The filly gets into an ideal spot tracking the leader but compounds traffic problems when weakening, allowing an outsider like Hood Wink to sneak through. Her fade creates gaps for others to exploit late.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Harswell River gets uncontested lead through half-mile as no obvious pace pressure exists early
Monitor Gloriola's position turning in as her finishing fade tendency could cause traffic problems late
Check how Truly Special handles return from 171-day layoff in early stages under pressure from Tudhope
Observe if hold-up horses get proper pace to aim at as moderate early gallop may not suit their style
Note Alice's Influence with first-time visor as headgear change could spark improvement from hold-up spot

races.paceDynamic: Princling is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without pressure. The prominent runners Picture Palace and Unchartedterritory lack the early pace to challenge Princling's lead, while the hold-up horses Oathbound, Freddie Steady Go and Lorton Valley will be dependent on the pace being strong enough. With such a small field and limited pace pressure, Princling can control the gallop and kick clear when ready. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Princling Controls Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Princling breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The leader dictates a comfortable gallop before quickening approaching the final furlong, with any challenges coming too late. This controlled pace perfectly suits horses who can travel prominently and have the tactical speed to respond.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Catches Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get a strong enough gallop to close into and time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: Oathbound or Freddie Steady Go produce telling late surges as Princling's stamina gives way in the final 100 yards. The patient tactics pay dividends if the fractions are honest enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Picture Palace or Unchartedterritory can lay closer to Princling than usual and pounce
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners shadows the leader throughout before delivering a decisive challenge inside the final furlong. Their tactical positioning proves superior to both leader and closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Newcomer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Cliff Danger or Ervani show significantly improved form on their breeding and connections
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runners with higher official ratings demonstrate untapped ability that their limited experience hasn't revealed. Class tells despite tactical disadvantages.

watchPoints.text: Watch for market moves on Cliff Danger or Ervani as their lightly-raced status could hide significant improvement
Monitor Princling's jumping from the stalls as any slow start would compromise his front-running tactics completely
Observe how aggressively Picture Palace and Unchartedterritory position early as this will determine pressure on the leader
Check if hold-up horses Oathbound and Freddie Steady Go show early alertness despite their patient styles
Watch for any late scratches given the small field size which could dramatically alter pace dynamics

races.paceDynamic: Sanaam and Hasbro Market will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to go forward from the off. Evening Blues, Beyond The Bar, Shahik and Passing Thought should track just behind this early pace, creating a decent gallop over the 7f trip. The sustained pace should set up well for those who can finish strongly, particularly the hold-up horses who can capitalize on any weakening of the pace-setters in the final furlong. This race shape clearly favours the closers and hold-up artists who can produce their best work late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sanaam and Hasbro Market duel too hard early and both weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The honest gallop becomes unsustainable and the leaders falter badly, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Gold Queen Kindly, Back To Me and Harswell Angel are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but sustainable, allowing those tracking to kick clear
scenarios.body: Evening Blues or Beyond The Bar can utilize their prominent positions to strike at the right moment before the hold-up horses get organized. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the weakening leaders while staying clear of traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets an uncontested or soft lead and has enough left
scenarios.body: Hasbro Market's superior class tells if he can dictate terms without serious pressure, holding off the late charge with his proven 7f ability. His recent win over this trip suggests he can rate better than pure front runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Completely Falls Apart
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too conservatively creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with no true pace, turning into a raw speed contest that could suit any horse with a quick turn of foot regardless of style. Supreme Clarets' low weight becomes a decisive factor in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Sanaam and Hasbro Market both go forward aggressively from the start as this will create the honest pace that suits the closers
Monitor if Evening Blues or Beyond The Bar can get the perfect tracking position behind the leaders without getting caught wide
Observe Gold Queen Kindly's early positioning as her hold-up style needs the leaders to go a strong pace to be effective
Check if Back To Me can overcome the 21-day gap since his last run when transitioning from his recent winning form
Watch Supreme Clarets early to see if the 5lb claim allows Ethan Tindall to get him into a handy position despite his hold-up style

races.paceDynamic: Miss Lady Grace will lead unchallenged with Rosa Inglesa, Come On Eibhlin and In A Hurry settling prominent, creating a modest gallop over this 7f trip. The early pace will be sustainable with no genuine speed merchants to apply pressure, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through the opening 4f. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses Secret History, Art Gallery, Mereside Diva and Folkene to close strongly in the final 2f. The race shape heavily favours late-running types who can produce a finishing kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace sets steady fractions unopposed through halfway
scenarios.body: The patient riders can time their challenges perfectly as the early leaders weaken approaching the final furlong. Secret History and Art Gallery emerge as the main beneficiaries with their proven ability to quicken late over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Rosa Inglesa or In A Hurry press Miss Lady Grace earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A more honest pace develops which suits the horses who can race handily and sustain their effort to the line. Rosa Inglesa's class and In A Hurry's consistent 7f form make them the primary beneficiaries of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to repel all challengers despite the tactical disadvantage. Her recent 7f wins demonstrate the capability to lead throughout when unopposed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes crawling slow and no one challenges until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where fitness and recent race-sharpness become crucial factors. Art Gallery and Secret History benefit most from their recent competitive outings.

watchPoints.text: Miss Lady Grace could get uncontested fractions if Rosa Inglesa and In A Hurry settle too far back early

races.paceDynamic: West Tyrone will take the field along as the only confirmed front-runner, with Zarathos, Dovey Moon and Sea Suite likely to track him in prominent positions early. This singular pace angle means West Tyrone can dictate terms without pressure, creating a sustainable gallop that will suit his stamina reserves over this mile trip. The lack of early pace competition sets up a tactical race where hold-up horses with finishing kicks will find it harder to peg back the front division. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those that can travel kindly in the first half of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If West Tyrone sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses can follow his tempo
scenarios.body: The front division maintains their advantage as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the straight. Zarathos and Dovey Moon are perfectly positioned to capitalize on the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows the back markers to get into contention, with American State and Harswell Ruby finding room to unleash their finishing kicks. Mount King's low weight becomes a crucial advantage in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: West Tyrone Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If West Tyrone's front-running tactics prove perfectly judged for the conditions
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage throughout, with the chasers unable to reel him in despite his modest recent form. His stamina reserves and lack of early pressure prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with the best finishing kicks, particularly those held up furthest back, sweep past tiring leaders. Chesneys Charm and Dark Rosa benefit from patient rides and strong finishes.

races.paceDynamic: True Promise will take the early lead with limited pressure, as the only confirmed front runner in this small field. Ingleby Archie and Without Flaw may sit prominent but both have shown they can settle, leaving True Promise relatively uncontested through moderate fractions. The majority of the field (King's Crown, Dorney Lake, Shavkat, Alpine Girl, Glory Hyde) are hold-up horses who will be tracking from midfield and behind. This setup creates a tactical race with an uncontested leader and plenty of closers, strongly favoring horses with late kick who can benefit from the solid pace True Promise will set.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs correctly from the generous pace
scenarios.body: True Promise sets honest fractions but the sheer weight of closers overwhelms the leaders in the final furlong. King's Crown and Shavkat benefit most with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows True Promise to retain enough energy for a sustained drive, holding off the late challenges. Without Flaw may get closest of the prominent racers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ingleby Archie or Without Flaw get perfect stalking positions behind True Promise
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run on the leader while the hold-up brigade leave their move too late. Ingleby Archie's class tells despite the long layoff.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint from the turn
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a dash where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. Shavkat's raw speed advantage becomes decisive.
